tool.name: Boltz-2
tool.description: Protein-ligand structure and binding affinity prediction
tool.command: boltz predict '$input_fasta' --out_dir output/ --diffusion_samples $diffusion_samples #if $use_msa_server --use_msa_server #end if #if $use_potentials --use_potentials #end if && cp output/*/predictions/*/*.cif '$output_structure' 2>/dev/null || echo "No structure output" && cp output/*/predictions/*/affinity_*.json '$output_affinity' 2>/dev/null || echo "No affinity output"

param.name: ligand_smiles
param.label: Ligand SMILES
param.help: SMILES string of the ligand molecule

param.name: use_msa_server
param.label: Use MSA server
param.help: Use ColabFold MSA server for alignments

tool.help:
**Boltz-2: Protein-Ligand Structure Prediction**
Boltz-2 is a unified model for biomolecular structure and binding affinity prediction.
**Inputs:** - Protein sequence in FASTA format - Optional: Ligand SMILES string
**Outputs:** - Predicted 3D structure (CIF format) - Binding affinity prediction (JSON)
**Requirements:** - GPU with 16-40GB VRAM recommended - Uses ColabFold MSA server by default
**Citation:** Wohlwend et al. (2025). Boltz-2: A unified model for biomolecular structure and affinity prediction. https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz
